d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
Join HealthHub's New Community Healthcare Clinic in Dubailand
HealthHub Clinics, part of Al-Futtaim Health, is seeking an experienced Registered Nurse to join our multidisciplinary team at our new HealthHub clinic in Dubailand.

Located within one of Dubai's growing residential areas, our new clinic will provide an exciting opportunity to support the healthcare needs of patients and families living in Dubailand and surrounding communities.
We are looking for a Registered Nurse who is passionate about delivering safe, compassionate and patient-centred care and who enjoys working within a busy outpatient healthcare environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a nurse looking for a supportive clinical environment, a 5-day working week and long-term career development within Al-Futtaim Health. The five-day proposition is consistent with your existing internal nursing advert. Registered Nurse Generic
As a Registered Nurse, you will play a key role in supporting physicians and patients while delivering safe, effective and compassionate nursing care.

You will support the day-to-day delivery of high-quality outpatient healthcare services, including patient assessment, clinical procedures, medication administration, patient education and clinical documentation.
q: DHA Registered Nurse licence or DHA Eligibility Letter.
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Nursing.
Previous nursing experience within an outpatient clinic, medical centre, ambulatory care or hospital environment.
Good Computer Skills And Experience With Clinical Documentation.
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
Ability to commute daily to Dubailand, Dubai.
Previous outpatient, primary care or Family Medicine experience.
Strong venepuncture and IV cannulation skills.
Experience supporting physicians across multidisciplinary healthcare services.
Experience working with a diverse patient population.
Tagalog language skills as a second language.
r: Deliver high-quality, patient-centred nursing care within a busy outpatient clinic.
Support physicians during consultations, examinations and clinical procedures.
Conduct patient assessments and accurately record observations and vital signs.
Administer medications, injections and treatments as prescribed.
Provide patient education, health promotion and follow-up support.
Support the safe and effective coordination of patient care.
Work collaboratively with physicians, nurses and other members of the multidisciplinary healthcare team.
Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation and electronic medical records.
Promote a professional, compassionate and positive patient experience.
Perform IV cannulation and support IV therapy.
Prepare patients for diagnostic and clinical procedures.
Assist physicians with outpatient procedures as required.
Support medication administration and other nursing treatments within scope of practice.
Maintain accurate clinical records and documentation.
Maintain high standards of patient safety and clinical care.
Comply with applicable DHA requirements and HealthHub clinical standards.
Adhere to infection prevention and control policies and procedures.
Follow safe medication and clinical practice requirements.
Participate in continuing professional development and quality improvement activities.
x: Opportunity to join a new HealthHub clinic in Dubailand.
Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities.
Opportunity to become part of the team from the early stages of a new clinic.

Al-Futtaim Health is the healthcare division of the Al-Futtaim Group, delivering integrated, community-based healthcare across the UAE. d: The job holder shall manage and assess overseas treatment cases by reviewing clinical information, coordinating with relevant stakeholders, and monitoring cases throughout the patient's treatment journey. The role ensures informed decision-making, continuity of care, accurate documentation, timely risk escalation, and compliance with applicable regulations, policies, and approved treatment standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Medicine (MBBS/MD) or Nursing, with current or previously held registration. Active clinical practice not required.
Physician (MBBS/MD) preferred. Postgraduate qualification in health administration, public health or a clinical specialty, and case management certification (CCM/ACM), preferred.

[5–7] years post-qualification experience in clinical practice, case management, or international patient coordination, out of which [3] years in overseas referral or case assessment, with placement responsibility.
Essential: Ability to interpret clinical documentation; hospital, insurer, and TPA liaison; Arabic and English.
Preferred: Experience with USA, European, and Asian hospital systems; escort arrangements; referral data analysis.

[5–7] years post-qualification experience in clinical practice, medical case management, utilisation review, or international patient coordination, out of which [3] years in active case management or case oversight, monitoring cases against a treatment plan.
Essential: Interpreting clinical documentation; recognising stalled or deviating treatment; preparing case submissions for approval; Arabic and English.
Preferred: Familiarity with USA, European, and Asian hospital systems; utilization review or length-of-stay management; outcome data analysis.

[5–7] years post-qualification in clinical practice, case management, discharge planning or care coordination, out of which [3] years in transitions of care, care continuity or patient navigation across providers.

Essential: Interpreting discharge documentation; arranging care across multiple providers; working knowledge of HMC, PHCC and private provision; medication continuity and formulation differences; Arabic and English.
Preferred: Discharge planning within a Qatar facility; rehabilitation and home care arrangement.
r: Manage and assess assigned overseas treatment cases in accordance with approved regulations, bylaws, decrees, policies, and procedures.
Review and evaluate medical reports, treatment plans, clinical information, and supporting documentation to facilitate informed decision-making.
